settings.heading: When will my sweater ship?
settings.content: Pre-orders knit within 7 business days, then ship via UPS or DHL. Tracking lands in your inbox + SMS.

settings.heading: How do the lights work?
settings.content: Each sweater includes a removable LED micro strand with USB-C rechargeable pack (4-hour glow).

settings.heading: What about returns?
settings.content: We offer free exchanges within 60 days and instant store credit, or refunds to original payment.

settings.heading: Care instructions
settings.content: Slide the LED strand out, turn inside-out, cold gentle cycle, lay flat to dry.
